inputs.text: [curious] off… THAL… moh… SOR… us. "Ophthalmo" means eye — like an ophthalmologist, [serious] the doctor who checks your eyes. And "saurus," lizard.
[happily] That's the one. He lived one hundred fifty million years ago, [amazed] in the shallow seas of Europe and North America.
[curious] Why such big eyes, for a sea lizard?
[serious] That's exactly his thing. We're getting there.
